items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Small, clear change that matches the surrounding style. The added comment explains why auth has to be re-joined onto netloc.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: 4-line fix inside the existing function. It reuses parse_url's auth field, adds no new helpers and leaves no dead code.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: `netloc or ''` guards against a None netloc when auth is present (e.g. 'http://user:pass@'), which would otherwise raise TypeError in join. No swallowed errors.

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: Signature unchanged. The only change is to re-attach auth from parse_url; URLs without auth take the same path as before. No urllib3 pinning or Python-version check. Hidden tests pass (F2P 2/2, P2P 185/185).
